summary: First iteration testing of Colecle EAMS. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass covering auth (login/me/invalid), brand GET/PUT, KPIs with domain_counts for all 6 domains, objects seed count (27), business filter=10, full CRUD with cascade rel deletion, traceability forward from CAP-01 reaching application/data/technology (with depth=8), impact grouping, search, and ADR/Standard/Risk/Review CRUD + review stage advance/invalid. Frontend: end-to-end Playwright walkthrough passes - login->dashboard, 6 domain cards render, domain repo table (10 seeded biz), create+delete object, global search dropdown->object detail, Object Detail tabs (overview/relations/impact/attributes) + Traceability SVG with forward/reverse/both direction buttons, Architecture Map, Reviews create+advance, ADRs create, Standards create, Risks create, Brand admin save with live preview reflecting name change.

minor.issue: Default depth=4 is insufficient to walk from a top capability (e.g., CAP-01) all the way to technology objects (6+ hops). Consider raising default depth to 8 or documenting the limitation. Not a bug per se; frontend passes explicit depth.

issues: React console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - add DialogDescription for a11y compliance

action_items: Optional: raise default traceability depth to 8 in server.py or document explicit depth requirement.
Optional a11y: add <DialogDescription> to each shadcn DialogContent to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False - fine because frontend uses Bearer tokens (localStorage). The cookie set on login with secure=True,samesite='none' will not be usable by the browser cross-site given allow_credentials=False, but this is not needed because frontend uses Bearer.
seed_admin_and_data updates admin password if changed - good idempotent behavior.
kpis endpoint runs 15+ sequential Mongo count_documents calls - could be optimized with aggregation for scale but acceptable for MVP.
Traceability walk uses BFS with linear scan over all_rels per node (O(N*E)) - acceptable at seed scale (32 rels) but should be indexed by source/target for larger datasets.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 27 objects + 32 relationships + 4 standards + 2 ADRs + 2 risks + 1 review on startup when objects collection is empty (idempotent).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend + frontend flows verified in iteration 1. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_eams_api.py for regression. Traceability tests must pass depth>=6 when walking from top capabilities. Admin creds are seeded from env. Global search debounces at 200ms - wait for [data-testid='global-search-results']. Modal Dialogs emit Radix a11y warnings but functionally OK.
